author: John Hammond
description:
What makes a fake notification convincing?

This proof of concept explores how trusted Windows features can be used to make notifications appear as though they came from familiar applications. Understanding how these techniques work helps defenders recognize how legitimate functionality can be abused for phishing and social engineering.

Watch the full video here: https://youtu.be/wrAFZLa1TAk?si=CxyHDhZ_iMSh3Ia1
title: Any App Notification
